issues.description: Constructor parameter order mismatch for class Lecture: The problem statement / UML requires the constructor parameters in this order: (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). The solution implementation declares the constructor as: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents). This difference in parameter order is likely to confuse students implementing the constructor to match the UML and may lead to incorrect assignments or failing tests that expect the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML in the problem statement. Update the solution (and template) constructor signature to: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and assign fields accordingly (this.lectureName = lectureName; this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; etc.). Alternatively, if the solution order was intentional, update the problem statement / UML to document the constructor signature used in the solution so students and tests agree.
